en.t: King Charles VI of France grants a monopoly for the ripening of Roquefort cheese to the people of Roquefort-sur-Soulzon, as they had been doing for centuries
en.s: Charles VI (3 December 1368 – 21 October 1422), nicknamed the Beloved (French: le Bien-Aimé) and in the 19th century, the Mad (French: le Fol or le Fou), was King of France from 1380 until his death in 1422. He is known for his mental illness and psychotic episodes that plagued him throughout his life, including glass delusion.

zh.t: 法国国王查理六世授予罗克福尔-叙尔-苏宗居民洛克福奶酪熟成专营权
zh.s: 查理六世（1368年12月3日—1422年10月21日），绰号“受爱戴者”（法语：le Bien-Aimé），19世纪又被称为“疯子”（法语：le Fol或le Fou），自1380年起担任法国国王，直至1422年去世。他以终身遭受精神疾病和精神病性发作为人所知，其中包括玻璃妄想。

en.s: The Battle of Serravalle took place on 2–4 June 1544 in Serravalle Scrivia, in the Apennine Mountains, between the Imperial-Spanish army commanded by Don Alfonso d'Avalos, Marquis del Vasto, and a force of freshly raised Italian mercenaries in French service, led by Pietro Strozzi, member of the rich and famous Florentine family of the Strozzi, and Giovan Francesco Orsini, Count of Pitigliano, during the Italian War of 1542–1546.

zh.s: 1544年6月2日至4日，意大利战争期间，塞拉瓦莱斯克里维亚（亚平宁山脉）发生战斗。交战双方为阿方索·达瓦洛斯（德尔瓦斯托侯爵）率领的西班牙—帝国军，以及彼得罗·斯特罗齐（佛罗伦萨名门斯特罗齐家族成员）和皮蒂利亚诺伯爵乔万·弗朗切斯科·奥尔西尼率领、为法国效力的新征募意大利雇佣军。

en.t: The steeple of St Paul's, the medieval cathedral of London, is destroyed in a fire caused by lightning, and is never rebuilt
en.s: Old St Paul's Cathedral was the cathedral of the City of London that, until the Great Fire of 1666, stood on the site of the present St Paul's Cathedral. Built in 1087 and from 1255 to 1314, it was dedicated to Paul the Apostle. The building was perhaps the fourth such St Paul's cathedral church at this site on Ludgate Hill, going back to the 7th century.

zh.t: 伦敦中世纪圣保罗大教堂的尖塔遭雷击引发的火灾焚毁，此后未再重建
zh.s: 旧圣保罗大教堂是伦敦城的主教座堂，直至1666年伦敦大火前一直矗立于现今圣保罗大教堂所在位置。该建筑始建于1087年，1255年至1314年间重建，奉献给使徒保罗。这里或许是这处圣保罗主教堂建筑的第四代，卢德门山上的教堂历史可追溯至7世纪。

en.s: This battle took place on 4 June 1565 between an allied fleet of 33 Danish and Lübecker ships, under Trolle, and a Swedish fleet of around 49 ships, under Klas Horn. Afterward, the Danes retired to Køge Bay, south of Copenhagen, where Trolle died of his wounds on 25 June. His second, Jørgen Brahe, died of fever on 28 June.

zh.s: 1565年6月4日，特罗勒指挥的丹麦与吕贝克盟军舰队（33艘船）和克拉斯·霍恩指挥的瑞典舰队（约49艘船）交战。战后，丹麦舰队撤至哥本哈根以南的克厄湾，特罗勒于6月25日伤重身亡。他的副手约根·布拉赫于6月28日因发烧去世。

en.s: The De la Gardie campaign was a joint military campaign by Russia and Sweden during the Polish–Russian War, which lasted from April 1609 to June 1610. Russia was unofficially occupied during the early Time of Troubles by the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which had supported False Dmitry II as the tsar of Russia since 1607. Tsar Vasili IV formed a military alliance with Sweden in 1609, providing a 5,000-strong auxiliary corps commanded by Jacob De la Gardie and Evert Horn to support Russian forces under Mikhail Skopin-Shuisky. The De la Gardie campaign was successful against False Dmitry II, dispersing his court in Tushino – a former village and town to the north of Moscow, but failed against the Polish–Lithuanians and was defeated at the Battle of Klushino on 4 June 1610.

zh.s: 德拉加尔迪远征是俄罗斯与瑞典在波兰—俄罗斯战争期间联合开展的军事行动，持续时间为1609年4月至1610年6月。当时正值俄罗斯“混乱时期”早期，波兰—立陶宛联邦自1607年起支持伪德米特里二世，并对俄国形成非正式占领。沙皇瓦西里四世于1609年与瑞典结盟，派雅各布·德拉加尔迪和埃弗特·霍恩指挥的5,000人辅助军团支援米哈伊尔·斯科平-舒伊斯基率领的俄军。远征军击败了伪德米特里二世，解散了他在图申诺的朝廷，但未能战胜波兰—立陶宛联军，并于1610年6月4日在克卢希诺战役中战败。

en.s: The siege of Osaka (大坂の役, Ōsaka no Eki; or, more commonly, 大坂の陣 Ōsaka no Jin) was a series of battles undertaken by the Japanese Tokugawa shogunate against the Toyotomi clan, ending in that clan's destruction. Divided into two stages, the winter campaign and the summer campaign, it lasted from 1614 to 1615. The siege put an end to the last major armed opposition to the establishment of the Tokugawa shogunate.
en.n: Siege of Osaka: Forces under Tokugawa Ieyasu take Osaka Castle in Japan.

zh.s: 大阪之战（日语：大坂の役，又称大坂の陣）是德川幕府对丰臣氏发动的一系列战役，最终导致丰臣氏灭亡。战争分为冬之阵和夏之阵两个阶段，持续时间为1614年至1615年。围城战结束了德川幕府建立过程中最后一场大规模武装抵抗。
zh.n: 大阪之战：德川家康的军队攻占日本大阪城。

en.t: Battle of the Gulf of Tunis
en.s: The Battle of the Gulf of Tunis was a naval battle between a Spanish and Maltese galley fleet, commanded by Álvaro de Bazán y Benavides, Marquis of Santa Cruz, and a Barbary corsair flotilla captained by Ali Arraez Rabazin.

zh.s: 突尼斯湾海战是一场西班牙、马耳他桨帆船舰队与巴巴里海盗船队之间的海战。前者由圣克鲁斯侯爵阿尔瓦罗·德·巴桑·伊·贝纳维德斯指挥，后者由阿里·阿拉埃斯·拉巴津率领。

en.s: The Battle of Cloghleagh, Cloghlea, Cloughleagh also known as the Battle of Funcheon Ford or the Battle of Manning Water, was a battle fought between a Protestant Royalist force and a Confederate Catholic force during the Wars of the Three Kingdoms. It took place south of Kilworth and north of Fermoy between the river Funcheon and the river Blackwater in County Cork on June 4, 1643.

zh.s: 克劳利格战役又称克洛格利格战役、克洛格利亚战役、芬申河渡口战役或曼宁水战役，是三王国战争期间新教保王派与天主教邦联军之间的一场战斗。战斗于1643年6月4日在爱尔兰科克郡基尔沃思以南、费莫伊以北的芬申河与布莱克沃特河之间发生。

en.s: The siege of Basing House near Basingstoke in Hampshire, was a Parliamentarian victory late in the First English Civil War. Whereas the title of the event may suggest a single siege, there were in fact three major engagements. John Paulet, 5th Marquis of Winchester owned the House and as a committed Royalist garrisoned it in support of King Charles I, as it commanded the road from London to the west through Salisbury. The first engagement was in November 1643, when Sir William Waller at the head of an army of about 7,000 attempted to take Basing House by direct assault.

zh.s: 汉普郡贝辛斯托克附近的贝辛庄园围城战，是第一次英国内战末期议会派的一场胜利。尽管名称听起来像一次围城，实际上发生过三场主要交战。温彻斯特侯爵约翰·波莱特是庄园所有者，也是坚定的保王派；庄园扼守经索尔兹伯里从伦敦通往西部的道路，他因此驻军支持查理一世。第一次交战发生在1643年11月，威廉·沃勒爵士率约7000人试图正面攻取庄园。

en.s: The Battle of Ösel Island took place on May 24(4 June), 1719 (O.S.), during the Great Northern War. It was fought near the island of Saaremaa (Ösel). It led to a victory for the Russian captain Naum Senyavin, whose forces captured three enemy vessels, sustaining as few as eighteen casualties. It was the first Russian naval victory which did not involve ramming or boarding actions.
en.n: The Battle of Ösel Island took place on 4 June 1719 (N.S.), during the Great Northern War.

zh.s: 大北方战争期间，1719年6月4日（新历；旧历5月24日），厄塞尔岛（今萨雷马岛）附近发生厄塞尔岛海战。俄罗斯海军上校瑙姆·谢尼亚温获胜，俘获三艘敌舰，己方伤亡仅18人。这是俄罗斯海军首次在未使用撞击或接舷战术的情况下取得胜利。
zh.n: 大北方战争期间，厄塞尔岛海战于1719年6月4日（新历）发生。

en.s: The siege of Menin took place between 28 May and 4 June 1744 during the War of the Austrian Succession, and was the first battle fought in the Austrian Netherlands. A French army under the nominal command of King Louis XV and operational command of the Duke of Noailles, took the city from its Dutch garrison after a short siege.

zh.s: 奥地利王位继承战争期间，梅嫩围城战于1744年5月28日至6月4日进行，是奥属尼德兰发生的第一场战役。法国军队名义上由路易十五国王统帅，实际由诺阿耶公爵指挥；经过短暂围城后，法军从荷兰驻军手中夺取了该城。

en.s: The Battle of Hohenfriedberg or Hohenfriedeberg (now Dobromierz, Poland), also known as the Battle of Striegau (now Strzegom, Poland) was one of Frederick the Great's most admired victories. Frederick's Prussian army decisively defeated an Austro-Saxon army under Prince Charles Alexander of Lorraine on June 4, 1745, during the Second Silesian War – part of the War of the Austrian Succession.

zh.s: 霍恩弗里德贝格战役（也作Hohenfriedeberg；现波兰多布罗梅日）亦称施特里高战役（现波兰斯特热戈姆），是腓特烈大帝最受称颂的胜利之一。1745年6月4日，腓特烈率领的普鲁士军队在第二次西里西亚战争期间，决定性击败了洛林亲王卡尔·亚历山大率领的奥地利—萨克森联军。第二次西里西亚战争是奥地利王位继承战争的一部分。

en.s: The Battle of Kronstadt (Russian: Красногорское сражение, lit. 'Battle of Krasnaya Gorka') was a naval battle fought in the Gulf of Finland west of Kronstadt on 3–4 June 1790. The Swedish naval forces sought to engage the Kronstadt squadron of Russian fleet and defeat them both to prevent Russian squadrons from joining and also to open the sea route to Kronstadt and Saint Petersburg.

zh.s: 1790年6月3日至4日，芬兰湾克朗施塔特以西发生海战，俄语称“Красногорское сражение”，意为“克拉斯纳亚戈尔卡战役”。瑞典海军试图与俄国舰队的克朗施塔特分舰队交战并将其击败，以阻止俄国其他分舰队会合，并打通通往克朗施塔特和圣彼得堡的海上航道。

en.s: The Battle of Altenkirchen (4 June 1796) saw two Republican French divisions commanded by Jean Baptiste Kléber attack a wing of the Habsburg Austrian army led by Duke Ferdinand Frederick Augustus of Württemberg. A frontal attack combined with a flanking maneuver forced the Austrians to retreat. Three future Marshals of France played significant roles in the engagement: François Joseph Lefebvre as a division commander, Jean-de-Dieu Soult as a brigadier and Michel Ney as leader of a flanking column. The battle occurred during the War of the First Coalition, part of a larger conflict called the Wars of the French Revolution.

zh.s: 1796年6月4日，法国共和军两支师在让-巴蒂斯特·克莱贝尔指挥下，进攻由符腾堡公爵费迪南德·腓特烈·奥古斯特率领的哈布斯堡奥地利军一翼。法军正面进攻并配合侧翼包抄，迫使奥地利军撤退。后来成为法国元帅的三人在战斗中发挥了重要作用：弗朗索瓦·约瑟夫·勒费弗尔担任师长，让-德-迪厄·苏尔特担任准将，米歇尔·内伊率领侧翼纵队。此战发生于第一次反法同盟战争期间，该战争属于更广泛的法国大革命战争。

en.s: The siege of Mantua lasted from 4 June 1796 to 2 February 1797 with a short break where French forces under the overall command of Napoleon Bonaparte besieged and blockaded a large Austrian garrison at Mantua for many months until it surrendered. The siege was the focal point of the Italian Campaign of 1796-1797, lasting the vast majority of the campaign and being the hinge point that would determine which side would control Northern Italy.

zh.s: 法国军队于1796年6月4日至1797年2月2日围困并封锁意大利曼图亚的大型奥地利驻军，期间短暂中断。围城战持续数月，最后以奥军投降告终。拿破仑·波拿巴统帅法军。围城战贯穿1796—1797年意大利战役的大部分时期，是决定北意大利归属的关键战事。

en.s: The Battle of Tubberneering (also Tuberneering or Toberanierin) took place during the Wexford Rebellion fought on 4 June 1798 between Crown forces and United Irish insurgents, at Tubberneering (modern townlands of Toberanierin North and Toberanierin South) south of Gorey in the north of County Wexford. The rebels ambushed and routed the British.

zh.s: 1798年6月4日，韦克斯福德起义期间，王室军队与爱尔兰联合会起义军在塔伯尼林交战。塔伯尼林（今北塔伯尼林和南塔伯尼林镇区）位于爱尔兰韦克斯福德郡北部、戈里的南面。起义军伏击并击溃了英国军队。

en.s: The siege of Genoa saw an Austrian army led by Michael von Melas besiege the port of Genoa, which was occupied by a French garrison under the command of André Massena, from 19 April to 4 June 1800. It formed part of the larger Marengo campaign during the War of the Second Coalition. The Austrian army isolated Massena and half of the French army in Genoa, while driving the other half from the area.

zh.s: 1800年4月19日至6月4日，迈克尔·冯·梅拉斯率领的奥地利军队围攻由安德烈·马塞纳指挥的法军驻守的热那亚港。此战是第二次反法同盟战争期间马伦哥战役的一部分。奥军将马塞纳和一半法军困在热那亚，同时将另一半法军逐出该地区。

en.t: King Charles Emmanuel IV of Sardinia abdicates his throne in favor of his brother, Victor Emmanuel
en.s: Charles Emmanuel IV (Carlo Emanuele Ferdinando Maria; 24 May 1751 – 6 October 1819) was King of Sardinia and ruler of the Savoyard states from 16 October 1796 until 1802, when he abdicated in favour of his brother Victor Emmanuel I.

zh.t: 撒丁岛国王卡洛·埃马努埃莱四世退位，由其弟维托里奥·埃马努埃莱继位
zh.s: 卡洛·埃马努埃莱四世（Carlo Emanuele Ferdinando Maria；1751年5月24日—1819年10月6日）自1796年10月16日起担任撒丁岛国王及萨伏依诸邦统治者，直至1802年退位，将王位让给弟弟维托里奥·埃马努埃莱一世。

en.s: The Battle of Luckau was fought at Luckau in Brandenburg on 4 June 1813 during the War of the Sixth Coalition. Prussian and Russian forces under General Friedrich Wilhelm von Bülow defeated part of a French-Allied corps under Marshal Nicolas Oudinot.

zh.s: 第六次反法同盟战争期间，1813年6月4日，勃兰登堡州卢考发生战斗。弗里德里希·威廉·冯·比洛将军率领的普鲁士和俄罗斯军队击败了尼古拉·乌迪诺元帅指挥的法军盟军一部。

en.s: The Battle of Redon, fought on June 4, 1815, was a significant clash during the Chouannerie of 1815, where the royalist Chouan forces led by Louis de Sol de Grisolles attacked the town of Redon. Despite their numerical advantage of 4,000–5,000 troops against a small Imperial garrison of 120 men, the Chouans could not capture the town due to their lack of artillery and withdrew after intense fighting.

zh.s: 雷东战役于1815年6月4日发生，是1815年保王党舒昂运动期间的一场重要战斗。路易·德·索尔·德·格里索勒率领的保王党舒昂军队进攻雷东镇。尽管舒昂军有4,000至5,000人，人数远多于仅有120人的帝国驻军，但他们缺乏火炮，未能攻占该镇，激战后撤退。

en.t: 1844 Costa Rican Head of State election
en.s: Head of State elections were held in Costa Rica between 1 and 4 June 1844 to elect a Head of State for a four-year term. They were the first—and only—head of state election in the country's history to be conducted by direct popular vote, as provided for by the Constitution of 9 April 1844.

zh.t: 1844年哥斯达黎加国家元首选举
zh.s: 哥斯达黎加于1844年6月1日至4日举行国家元首选举，任期四年。这是该国历史上首次、也是唯一一次以直接普选方式选举国家元首，依据为1844年4月9日颁布的宪法。

en.s: The first Battle of Heligoland took place on 4 June 1849 during the First Schleswig War and pitted the fledgling Reichsflotte (Imperial Fleet) against the Royal Danish Navy, which had blocked German naval trade in North Sea and Baltic Sea since early 1848. The outcome was inconclusive, with no casualties, and the blockade went on. It remained the only battle of the German fleet.

zh.s: 第一次石勒苏益格战争期间，1849年6月4日，初创的德意志帝国舰队与丹麦皇家海军在黑尔戈兰岛海域交战。自1848年初以来，丹麦舰队一直封锁德国在北海和波罗的海的海上贸易。这场首次黑尔戈兰海战没有定论，也没有人员伤亡，封锁仍在继续。这是德国舰队唯一一次参战。

en.s: The Battle of Mesaimeer (Arabic: وقعة مسيمير) was a significant military engagement that took place from June 2 to June 4, 1851, near the village of Mesaimeer in Qatar. The conflict primarily involved Qatari forces led by Mohammed bin Thani and Jassim bin Mohammed Al Thani, then under Bahraini suzerainty, against the invading army of Faisal bin Turki, Imam of Emirate of Nejd, who was seeking to stage his third invasion attempt of Bahrain from the peninsula.

zh.s: 1851年6月2日至4日，卡塔尔梅赛迈尔村附近发生梅赛迈尔战役，阿拉伯语称“وقعة مسيمير”。当时卡塔尔处于巴林宗主权之下。穆罕默德·本·萨尼和贾西姆·本·穆罕默德·阿勒萨尼率领卡塔尔军队，抵御内志酋长国伊玛目费萨尔·本·图尔基率领的入侵军。费萨尔此行是第三次试图从半岛入侵巴林。

en.s: The Battle of Choloki took place on 4 June 1854 on the outskirts of village Kakuti in Guria, Georgia during the Crimean War. Under the command of General Ivane Andronikashvili, the invading Turks were successfully repelled and defeated.

zh.s: 克里米亚战争期间，1854年6月4日，格鲁吉亚古里亚地区卡库蒂村郊外发生乔洛基战役。伊万·安德罗尼卡什维利将军指挥的部队成功击退并击败入侵的土耳其军队。

en.s: The Battle of Magenta was fought on 4 June 1859 during the Second Italian War of Independence, resulting in a French-Sardinian victory under Napoleon III against the Austrians under Marshal Ferencz Gyulai. It took place near the town of Magenta in northern Italy on 4 June 1859. Napoleon III's army crossed the Ticino River and outflanked the Austrian right forcing the Austrian army under General Gyulay to retreat. en.s: The Brusilov offensive (Russian: Брусиловский прорыв, romanized: Brusilovskiĭ proryv, lit. 'Brusilov's breakthrough') of June to September 1916 was the Russian Empire's greatest feat of arms during World War I and among the most lethal offensives in world history. The historian Graydon Tunstall called the Brusilov offensive the worst crisis of World War I for Austria-Hungary and the Triple Entente's greatest victory, but it came at a tremendous loss of life. The victory contributed to a morale upsurge among the Russian troops. The offensive's success led Russia's allies to reconsider their positions on postwar territorial concessions, including the status of Anatolia and the Bosphorus Strait. The offensive involved a major Russian attack against the armies of the Central Powers on the Eastern Front. Launched on 4 June 1916, it lasted until late September.

en.t: Nineteenth Amendment to the United States Constitution

en.s: The 1943 Argentine coup d'état, also known as the Revolution of '43, was a coup d'état on June 4, 1943, which ended the government of Ramón Castillo, who had been fraudulently elected to office of vice-president, as part of the period known as the Infamous Decade. The military was opposed to Governor Robustiano Patrón Costas, Castillo's hand-picked successor, the principal landowner in Salta Province, as well as a main stockholder in the sugar industry. The only serious resistance to the military coup came from the Argentine Navy, which confronted the advancing army columns at the Navy's School of Mechanics.

zh.s: 1943年6月4日，阿根廷发生政变，又称“43年革命”，结束了拉蒙·卡斯蒂略政府。卡斯蒂略曾在“臭名昭著的十年”期间通过舞弊当选副总统。军方反对卡斯蒂略指定的接班人、萨尔塔省省长鲁斯蒂亚诺·帕特龙·科斯塔斯；科斯塔斯是该省最大地主，也是制糖业主要股东。军方政变唯一遭遇的有力抵抗来自阿根廷海军，该部队在海军机械学校附近与推进中的陆军纵队交战。

en.s: General elections were held in Belgium on 4 June 1950. The result was a victory for the Christian Social Party, which won 108 of the 212 seats in the Chamber of Representatives and 54 of the 106 seats in the Senate. Voter turnout was 92.6%. This election was the last one in Belgian history were a single party achieved an absolute majority. Elections for the nine provincial councils were also held. The elections took place a few months after the divisive referendum on restoring King Leopold III to the throne (the Royal Question).

en.s: The 1968 New Jersey Democratic presidential primary was held on June 4, 1968, in New Jersey as one of the Democratic Party's statewide nomination contests ahead of the 1968 United States presidential election. McCarthy captured nineteen delegates by narrowly winning several of the state's suburban congressional districts, including nine out of ten delegates from Bergen County.

zh.s: 新泽西州于1968年6月4日举行民主党总统初选，是该党为1968年美国总统大选提名候选人而举行的全州初选之一。在具有约束力的代表票初选中，未表态代表以明显优势超过承诺支持尤金·麦卡锡的代表。麦卡锡在州内多个郊区国会选区小幅胜出，获得19名代表；其中，卑尔根县的10名代表中有9名支持他。

en.s: Tonga, officially known as the Kingdom of Tonga, is an island country in Polynesia, part of Oceania. The country has 171 islands, of which 45 are inhabited. en.s: The Fritz Von Erich Retirement Show was a major professional wrestling show held by World Class Championship Wrestling (WCCW) at the Texas Stadium on June 4, 1982. As the name indicates the show marked Fritz Von Erich's retirement from active in ring competition after 29 years of active competition. His retirement came shortly after his promotion "Big Time Wrestling" was renamed "World Class Championship Wrestling" as they were making an attempt to expand to a national promotion. In the main event Fritz Von Erich defeated King Kong Bundy to win the NWA American Heavyweight Championship.

en.s: The Three Rivers Film Festival is an annual film festival, held in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania. Sponsored by the Pittsburgh Filmmakers, Dollar Bank and the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center, the festival features foreign-language films, American independents, documentaries, shorts, local works and experimental cinema. It was founded in 1981 and had its first annual festival on June 4, 1982 with the screening of the locally shot Knightriders starring Ed Harris, Patricia Tallman and Tom Savini. The festival is the oldest and largest annual film festival in Western Pennsylvania. The Festivals 15th anniversary in 1996 featured Flirt.The 2012 festival featured over 50 films, was 3 weeks long and included visits by Curt Wootton and Chris Preksta.

zh.s: 三河电影节是每年在宾夕法尼亚州匹兹堡举行的电影节，由匹兹堡电影人组织、Dollar Bank和匹兹堡大学医学中心赞助，展映外语片、美国独立电影、纪录片、短片、地方作品和实验电影。电影节创办于1981年，首届于1982年6月4日举行，放映了在当地拍摄、由埃德·哈里斯、帕特里夏·塔尔曼和汤姆·萨维尼主演的《骑士》。它是宾夕法尼亚州西部历史最悠久、规模最大的年度电影节。1996年电影节举办第15周年活动，放映了《调情》。2012年电影节放映了50多部影片，历时三周，并邀请柯特·伍顿和克里斯·普雷斯塔出席。

en.s: The Arzamas explosion, also known as the Arzamas train disaster, was a railway accident that occurred on June 4, 1988, in Arzamas, Gorky Oblast, Soviet Union, when an explosion at a railway crossing killed 91 people and injured 1,500. The Arzamas train disaster occurred exactly a year before the Ufa train disaster, one of the deadliest railway accidents in Soviet and Russian history.

en.s: The Supreme Leader of Iran election, 1989 was an indirect election where the Assembly of Experts members voted to choose the second Supreme Leader of Iran. The election was held on June 4, 1989, the morning after Ruhollah Khomeini's death and Ali Khamenei was elected as his successor with 60 votes out of 74. According to the testimony of Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani in the chamber before voting, in accordance with Ruhollah Khomeini's wish, Ali Khamenei was a suitable successor for him. He testified that in a meeting in late March 1989, Ruhollah Khomeini was asked about lack of a suitable successor for him after Hussein-Ali Montazeri was deposed and then he replied that Ali Khamenei is suitable.

zh.s: 伊朗于1989年6月4日举行间接选举，由专家会议成员投票选出第二任伊朗最高领袖。这场选举在鲁霍拉·霍梅尼去世后的第二天上午举行。阿里·哈梅内伊以74票中的60票当选继任者。投票前，阿克巴尔·哈什米·拉夫桑贾尼在会议上作证说，根据霍梅尼的意愿，哈梅内伊是合适的继任人选。他还说，1989年3月下旬，霍梅尼曾被问及侯赛因-阿里·蒙塔泽里被撤职后缺乏合适继任者一事，霍梅尼当时回答说哈梅内伊合适。

It is the second-deadliest rail disaster in Soviet/Russian history after the 1944 Vereshchyovka train disaster, and the deadliest to occur during peacetime.

en.s: The 2009 Doncaster mayoral election was held on the 4 June 2009 to elect the Mayor of Doncaster. Peter Davies of the English Democrats won the election for the term, albeit with a slender majority of 50.4% compared to the runner-up's 49.6%. The election saw the English Democrats win the mayoralty from the previously Labour Party-held mayoralty, in what was called the party's "biggest electoral success".

en.s: The East Sussex County Council election, 2009 took place on 4 June 2009 as part of the 2009 United Kingdom local elections, having been delayed from 7 May, to coincide with elections to the European Parliament. en.t: 2009 Council of the Isles of Scilly election
en.s: Elections to the Council of the Isles of Scilly, a sui generis unitary authority in the far southwest of England, were held on 4 June 2009. The whole council of 21 members was up for election, with thirteen members elected in the St Mary's electoral division and another eight from the 'Off Islands', being two each from Bryher, St Martin's, St Agnes and Tresco.

en.s: The 2009 Cornwall Council election, was an election for all 123 seats on the council. Cornwall Council is a unitary authority that covers the majority of the ceremonial county of Cornwall, with the exception of the Isles of Scilly which have an independent local authority. en.t: June 2010 Democratic Party of Japan leadership election
en.s: The June 2010 Democratic Party of Japan leadership election was held on 4 June 2010. The election was held to replace outgoing president and Prime Minister Yukio Hatoyama, who resigned on 2 June amid plunging approval ratings and his failure to relocate the Futenma military base. Finance minister and deputy prime minister Naoto Kan was elected president, defeating backbencher Shinji Tarutoko by 291 votes to 129.

en.s: The 2011 Christy Ring Cup final was a hurling match played at Croke Park on 4 June 2011 to determine the winners of the 2011 Christy Ring Cup, the 7th season of the Christy Ring Cup, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the second tier hurling teams. en.s: A special election for Missouri's 8th congressional district was held on June 4, 2013 following the resignation of Jo Ann Emerson on January 22, 2013 to head the National Rural Electric Cooperative Association. A televised candidate's forum took place on May 27, 2013 at Southeast Missouri State University-Riverside Campus; all party candidates participated while the write-in candidate did not attend.

zh.s: 密苏里州第8国会选区于2013年6月4日举行特别选举，选出接替乔·安·埃默森的人选。埃默森于2013年1月22日辞职，出任全国农村电力合作社协会负责人。共和党和民主党各自选定候选人，没有举行初选。特别选举的缺席选票申请截止日为2013年5月29日。候选人论坛于5月27日在东南密苏里州立大学河滨校区举行并进行电视转播，各党候选人均出席，独立参选人未参加。

en.s: The 2013 North Miami mayoral election took place on June 4, 2013, following a primary election on May 14, 2013. Incumbent Mayor Andre Pierre was term-limited and unable to seek a third term. en.s: The 2013 mayoral election in Jackson, Mississippi took place on June 4, 2013, alongside other Jackson municipal races. City councilman Chokwe Lumumba was elected mayor in a landslide in the general election after defeating Jonathan Lee and incumbent mayor Harvey Johnson, Jr. in the primary.

en.t: 2016 U.S. Virgin Islands Democratic presidential caucuses

en.s: On June 4, 2023, a privately operated Cessna 560 Citation V carrying three passengers and a pilot crashed at approximately 3:23 p.m. Eastern Daylight Time (EDT) in the George Washington National Forest, Virginia, United States, killing the occupants, after the crew had been found unresponsive. The plane had previously flown above the no-fly zone over Washington, D.C., and was intercepted by F-16 fighter jets before it crashed.

en.s: The 2023 Mexican local elections, held on 4 June 2023, saw voters electing two governors for six-year terms and deputies for one state congress. In the gubernatorial elections, Morena flipped one state, while the Institutional Revolutionary Party defended its gubernatorial seat. Notably, Delfina Gómez Álvarez (MORENA) defeated Alejandra del Moral Vela (PRI) in the state of Mexico, ending 94 years of PRI rule in the state.

zh.s: 墨西哥于2023年6月4日举行地方选举，选民选出两名任期六年的州长和一个州议会的议员。在州长选举中，国家复兴运动党（MORENA）赢得一个原由其他政党执政的州，制度革命党则保住其州长席位。值得一提的是，MORENA候选人德尔菲娜·戈麦斯·阿尔瓦雷斯击败制度革命党候选人亚历杭德拉·德尔莫拉尔·贝拉，结束了制度革命党在墨西哥州长达94年的执政。

en.t: Eleven people are killed and 56 people are injured during a crowd crush incident outside M. Chinnaswamy Stadium in Bengaluru, India for the celebration of Royal Challengers Bengaluru's Indian Premier League victory
en.s: Crowd collapses and crowd crushes are catastrophic incidents that occur when a body of people becomes dangerously overcrowded. When numbers are up to about five people per square meter, the environment may feel cramped but manageable; when numbers reach between eight and ten people per square meter, individuals become pressed against each other and may be swept along against their will by the motion of the crowd.

zh.t: 印度班加罗尔M.奇纳斯瓦米体育场外发生人群挤压，11人死亡、56人受伤
zh.s: 人群倒塌和挤压事故是人群过度拥挤时可能发生的灾难。密度达到每平方米约5人时，现场可能让人感到拥挤，但尚可应对；当密度升至每平方米8至10人时，人们会被紧紧挤在一起，并可能被人流裹挟、无法自主行动。
